      public int getNumPlayers()
      Get the number of players sent. 获取发送的玩家数量。

    • setNumPlayers

      public void setNumPlayers(int numPlayers)
      Sets the number of players displayed in the server list. 设置服务器列表中显示的玩家数量。

      Note that this won't have any effect if shouldHidePlayers() is enabled.

      注意：如果启用了 shouldHidePlayers()，这将不会产生任何效果。
      参数:
      numPlayers - The number of online players 在线玩家数量

    • shouldHidePlayers

      public boolean shouldHidePlayers()
      Returns whether all player related information is hidden in the server list. This will cause getNumPlayers(), getMaxPlayers() and getPlayerSample() to be skipped in the response. 返回服务器列表中是否隐藏了所有玩家相关信息。这将使响应中跳过 getNumPlayers()、getMaxPlayers() 和 getPlayerSample()。

      The Vanilla Minecraft client will display the player count as ??? when this option is enabled.

      启用此选项后，原版 Minecraft 客户端会将玩家数量显示为 ???。
      返回:
      true if the player count is hidden 若玩家数量已隐藏则为 true

    • setHidePlayers

      public void setHidePlayers(boolean hidePlayers)
      Sets whether all player related information is hidden in the server list. This will cause getNumPlayers(), getMaxPlayers() and getPlayerSample() to be skipped in the response. 设置服务器列表中是否隐藏所有玩家相关信息。这将使响应中跳过 getNumPlayers()、getMaxPlayers() 和 getPlayerSample()。

      The Vanilla Minecraft client will display the player count as ??? when this option is enabled.

    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      Gets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins 获取此事件的取消状态。已取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件

      Cancelling this event will cause the connection to be closed immediately, without sending a response to the client.

      取消此事件将导致连接立即关闭，不向客户端发送任何响应。
      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      true if this event is cancelled 此事件已取消则为 true

      Cancelling this event will cause the connection to be closed immediately, without sending a response to the client.

    • iterator

      public Iterator<Player> iterator()

      Calling the Iterator.remove() method will force that particular player to not be displayed on the player list, decrease the size returned by ServerListPingEvent.getNumPlayers(), and will not be returned again by any new iterator. 调用 Iterator.remove() 方法将强制该特定玩家不再显示在玩家列表中，使 ServerListPingEvent.getNumPlayers() 返回的数量减一，并且不会再被任何新迭代器返回。

      Note: For compatibility reasons, this method will return all online players, not just the ones referenced in getPlayerSample(). Removing a player will:

      注意：出于兼容性原因，此方法会返回所有在线玩家，而不仅是 getPlayerSample() 中引用的玩家。移除玩家将会：

      • Decrement the online player count (if and only if) the player count wasn't changed by another plugin before.
        • 使在线玩家数量减一（当且仅当此前没有其他插件修改过玩家数量）。
      • Remove all entries from getPlayerSample() that refer to the removed player (based on their UUID).
        • 从 getPlayerSample() 中移除所有指向被移除玩家的条目（基于其 UUID）。
      指定者:
      iterator 在接口中 Iterable<Player>
      覆盖:
      iterator 在类中 ServerListPingEvent
